Chapter 217: Quite a Few Celebrities Came for Drinks

During his usual commute between the company and his dorm, a total distance of only one or two kilometers, Chen Guiliang naturally rode his bicycle.

This time, however, he was taking a car and bringing Yang Shuo along.

Driver and bodyguard!

Although Beijing's public security was good, there had been the kidnapping of CEO Yu of New Oriental, and later, the wife and child of the boss of Jiutouying. Chen Guiliang still had to be careful.

He wasn't too worried around Peking University, but he had to bring someone if he went a bit farther. Who knew if someone had their eyes on him?

Take the kidnapping of the Jiutouying boss's son next year, for example. The leader of the gang was actually the owner of a car repair shop. Just because the victim went there to get his car fixed, he felt the man was very rich and thus got three accomplices to commit the crime.

Moreover, they directly disguised themselves as men in uniform, pulling the car over under the pretext of a traffic violation, and carried out the kidnapping right at the entrance of the University of International Business and Economics. It was utterly audacious and impossible to guard against!

"You know the way, right?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Yang Shuo started the car and said, "I bought a traffic map of Beijing. When I have free time, I take the bus with the map. I've already familiarized myself with more than half of the city."

"Is this your version of reconnaissance?" Chen Guiliang laughed.

"You could say that," Yang Shuo said. "Since I'm a driver, how could I not be familiar with the roads? Sometimes, when the company's Jinbei van goes out, I'll ride shotgun and go along."

The restaurant was in Houhai, only about a 10-kilometer drive away.

There was a bit of traffic in the evening.

The situation around Houhai used to be quite complicated, with all sorts of illegal structures built haphazardly. To welcome the 2008 Olympics, they had cleared a circle of buildings along the lake in the past two years, widening the roads and renovating the hutongs.

It was mostly finished now, but in a few spots, the scaffolding had yet to be removed.

New bars, restaurants, and cafes were popping up in Houhai one after another.

The address Li Xunhuan sent to Chen Guiliang was inside a small siheyuan that had been renovated last year.

"We won't get a ticket, will we?" Yang Shuo glanced around.

This was clearly a fire lane that had been widened, but a long line of cars was parked along the side.

They didn't know where the nearest parking lot was either, so they simply parked next to the other cars and then asked for directions until they arrived outside the siheyuan.

It was quite lively inside; they could hear laughter as soon as they entered.

"President Chen, you're finally here!"

Li Xunhuan stood up to welcome them, then looked at Yang Shuo. "And this is?"

Chen Guiliang introduced him, "My friend, Yang Shuo. A veteran."

"That's perfect, Director Shang and Sha Yi are here today too," Li Xunhuan began the introductions. "This is Director Shang Jing, the director of *Story of the Cooking Class*. And Sha Yi, the pastry chef from the show."

Yang Shuo's eyes were already shining. He stepped forward, stood at attention, and saluted. "Hello, Old Squad Leader!"

Shang Jing and Sha Yi, both being military men, quickly stood at attention and returned the salute before smiling and shaking hands with Yang Shuo.

Chen Guiliang also walked over. Instead of shaking hands, he made a very chuunibyou gesture with his fingers. "Sunflower Acupoint Hand!"

Sha Yi played along perfectly, freezing on the spot with his mouth half-open.

"Hahaha!" Shang Jing was amused and burst out laughing.

Li Xunhuan then introduced the eldest among them, "This is also a screenwriter for *Home with Kids*, Mr. Fei Ming. Mr. Fei is 52 this year."

Fei Ming stood up and shook Chen Guiliang's hand. "I came uninvited today. I wanted to get a collector's edition set of Sanguosha cards from you."

This man was a board game enthusiast who would still play Werewolf in his 60s. He also liked to go to board game cafes by himself to play offline with young people he didn't know.

Wang Hailin, who championed the casting method of coal bosses, was considered his semi-apprentice.

"I've long admired your name," Chen Guiliang said. "Mr. Fei, just leave me your address, and I'll have someone deliver Sanguosha to your door tomorrow."

Fei Ming asked with a smile, "Where will the finals of this summer's Sanguosha league be held?"

Chen Guiliang said, "Last year was in Beijing, this year is in Shanghai."

"That's too far, or I'd definitely go," Fei Ming said with regret.

Li Xunhuan continued the introductions, "This is Yu Baimei."

"Haha, Mr. Dou," Chen Guiliang said with a smile as he shook his hand.

This was the man who had a cameo as the painting teacher, Mr. Dou, in *Wulin Waizhuan*.

He would have another identity in the future: a producer of *Wolf Warrior 2*.

But what left a deeper impression on Chen Guiliang were the movies he directed, *The Breakup Guru* and *Devil and Angel*. They were truly boring!

Yu Baimei asked, "President Chen, you watch *Wulin Waizhuan* too?"

"Our whole dorm watches it," Chen Guiliang said.

Li Xunhuan said again, "This is Director Huang Ying, a teacher from the directing department at the Central Academy of Drama."

"Hello, Teacher Huang," Chen Guiliang shook hands again.

Huang Ying was only a few years older than Chen Guiliang. He wasn't very close with Li Xunhuan and usually hung out with Ning Caishen, Xing Yusen, and the others.

The last to be introduced were Ning Caishen and Xing Yusen.

Facing the latter, Chen Guiliang kept thinking of Constable Xing, unable to match the name to the person.

Ning Caishen shouted, "Boss, bring the drinks, bring the food!"

The restaurant specialized in luzhu, and also served some other Beijing dishes.

A large pot of luzhu was quickly brought out and placed in the center of the table. Surrounding the luzhu pot was a circle of other meat dishes.

Ning Caishen picked up and passed out bottles of beer, while Shang Jing, Sha Yi, and the others opened them. In a moment, everyone had a beer in hand, with only Yang Shuo declining to drink.

Ning Caishen raised his glass. "Today is mainly to welcome Old Lu, Li Xunhuan. This guy doesn't come to Beijing even once in a blue moon. I didn't expect we'd be able to invite President Chen, giving us the honor of dining with a new tycoon of the internet. We have to down the first glass. After that, drink as you please."

"Cheers!"

After downing a glass of beer and chewing on a couple of pieces of stewed pig intestine, the man raised his glass again. "President Chen, a toast to you! It's our first time meeting today. Let's keep in touch. If you need anything, I'm just a call away."

"Of course," Chen Guiliang replied with a smile, clinking glasses.

Ning Caishen put down his glass, took a few bites of luzhu, and then continued toasting everyone around the table. Damn, he really could hold his liquor.

Chen Guiliang was seated next to Sha Yi. Chewing on a piece of pig lung, he said, "What projects are you working on recently, Old Sha?"

Sha Yi replied, "Nothing. I'll be doing stage plays for a while first."

Yu Baimei said, "I just finished a script. Old Shang is directing it too. It'll be the original cast of *Wulin Waizhuan*, and Sha Yi has a role in it."

"That's great, you're already shooting a new series," Chen Guiliang said. "My website has quite a few celebrities who often promote their new shows online. Director Shang, you could bring your cast and crew to join as well."

Shang Jing asked, "Kaixin001?"

Chen Guiliang nodded. "Yes."

Shang Jing said, "I only found out about President Chen's Kaixin001 from a magazine a while ago. I heard even Chen Xiaoxu opened an account. How exactly does your website work?"

Chen Guiliang immediately gave a detailed introduction and even took out his phone. "You can also receive Weibo posts on your phone. See, this is a message I received on my way here to eat."

Shang Jing took the phone and immediately laughed. "Is this still going on?"

"Let me see," said Yu Baimei.

After reading the Weibo post, Yu Baimei also laughed and passed the phone to Huang Ying beside him.

It was a Weibo post from Tudou.com's CEO Wang Wei: "Tudou.com just received venture capital funding, and the next thing we know, we're getting a cease and desist letter from Director Chen. The *mantou* is [redacted]. We'll delete it as soon as possible, but we can't rule out the possibility of someone else re-uploading it."

This was about when Chen Kaige was at the Berlin Film Festival and was asked by a reporter for his opinion on *A Murder Case Caused by a Mantou*.

The joke had actually made it all the way to Berlin, and Chen Kaige was instantly infuriated. As soon as he and his wife returned to China, they were cornered by reporters at the airport, who again asked about *A Murder Case Caused by a Mantou*.

The great Director Chen finally couldn't hold it in anymore. He lambasted that a person couldn't be so shameless and said he would sue Hu Ge for copyright infringement over the parody video.

Subsequently, Director Chen also sent a cease and desist letter to Powerise, which scared them into quickly removing *Mantou* from their download section. Now, he had sent another letter to Tudou.com, demanding the immediate removal of the *Mantou* video.

After reading the Weibo post, Fei Ming, who was over fifty, quickly asked how to sign up for this thing. He wanted to try surfing the web on his phone too.

When the phone reached Ning Caishen, he complained, "A major international director suing someone who makes parody videos. What a fucking loss of face!"

"Even if he wins the lawsuit, he'll still be a joke," Xing Yusen commented.

Fei Ming analyzed, "Chen Kaige might suspect someone put him up to it. I watched an interview a few days ago, and Chen Kaige kept repeating the word 'motive.' He believes Hu Ge had a motive for making the parody video. What motive? He probably thinks Old Man Yimou hired someone to do it."

"Haha, when Old Man Yimou was interviewed a few days ago, he even deliberately fanned the flames," Huang Ying laughed. "Old Man Yimou said that if someone were to parody his movie, he certainly wouldn't be angry, since it's a form of entertainment for everyone."

Chen Guiliang thought of *Full River Red* and the "single take," and realized that Old Man Yimou's ability to take a hit was indeed much stronger than Director Chen's.

When the "single take" was parodied so relentlessly, Old Man Yimou didn't get angry. He even started laughing as he talked about it—amused by the parody content.

Perhaps Old Man Yimou's attitude was more pragmatic: *I'm just here to make a quick buck, and I knew you guys were going to curse me out anyway. No matter how harshly you curse, it won't affect my earnings one bit.*

In contrast, Director Chen knew he was making a quick buck but still postured as if it were for art, even fantasizing about receiving praise from the audience. He wanted to have his cake and eat it too.

Those present were mainly screenwriters, along with a director and an actor.

They were industry insiders and knew some rumors, more or less.

The topic quickly shifted to gossip about *The Promise*, and gradually to gossip about Chen Kaige and his wife.

Chen Guiliang listened with great interest.

It was the first time he learned that Chen Kaige's catchphrase was "wo cao," while Chen Hong's was "er bi." What a huge contrast to their artistic personas.

The group chatted from Chen Kaige to the Beijing circle, then in a few words veered off to Xu Jinglei, and proceeded to complain about the messy relationships within that Beijing circle.

Chen Guiliang truly got to hear a lot of juicy gossip.

After a few rounds of drinks, Chen Guiliang suddenly asked, "The copyright for *Wulin Waizhuan* is still with Beilian Pictures, right?"

"It should be. What does President Chen want to adapt it into?" Shang Jing asked.

Chen Guiliang said, "An online game."

Shang Jing said, "I'll ask for you."

The *Wulin Waizhuan* IP was about to be bought by Perfect World. God knows how they did it, but from project inception to open beta launch, it took them three or four months at most.

It was clearly an attempt to cash in quickly while the TV series was still popular.

From the graphics to the content, the game was made like a piece of shit. It took three years to improve it, but by then its reputation was completely ruined.

Even such a garbage game, relying on the powerful *Wulin Waizhuan* IP, saw its peak concurrent users quickly break through three to four hundred thousand—even more impressive than *Reign of Fire*'s promotion over several months!

Game Science didn't have the energy for it at the moment, but he could have Tao Chenggang buy the game rights.

After all, Bailian Technology couldn't rely solely on *Reign of Fire*.

This drinking session was quite fruitful. Shang Jing agreed to bring the *Wulin Waizhuan* cast and crew to register accounts on Kaixin001. At the same time, he would help inquire about the game rights for *Wulin Waizhuan*.

Chen Guiliang was very much looking forward to them joining, especially Wushuang-meizi.

She was so fine.

(End of Chapter)
